existing_behavior: Each lease rereads the exact AWSCURRENT secret; replacement pickup and failure without fallback are covered by fake-client tests.
required_sequence: Identify an owner-approved issuer capable of creating and revoking scoped vendor keys; no management API is presumed available
Create a replacement without revoking the currently usable key
Validate replacement metadata once under separate explicit authorization, without generation
Atomically promote the validated replacement in the approved secret store
Drain outstanding leases for at least their maximum lifetime before revoking the predecessor
Retain non-secret version and revocation receipts; stop for reconciliation on uncertainty
failure_policy: Never fall back to a cached credential after secret retrieval fails; no automatic retry of uncertain issuance, promotion or revocation.
unresolved: Issuer capability, identity, scope and availability have not been verified
Secret store deployment, permission scope and cost are not authorized by repository approval
Scheduler and automatic rotation control plane are not deployed
